coverage: Free, open handbook by the Blind 75 author. Algo side: 18 short per-topic cheatsheets (array, string, hash table, recursion, sorting/searching, matrix, linked list, queue, stack, interval, tree, graph, heap, trie, DP, binary, math, geometry) sharing one template: intro, external readings, complexity table, interview gotchas, corner cases, a few named techniques, essential + recommended LeetCode questions. No code walkthroughs; depth is shallow by design. Also a 12-week study plan and the Grind 75 generator (prioritised 75-169 question list, filter by hours/difficulty/topic). System design is a curated link list with no framework of its own. Everything is free; course recommendations carry affiliate links.
